## Summary

**Every run-manifest reference resolves inside `resolved_dependencies` —
and the check is symmetric.** `hh-bundle::runrefs` is the single flat
`{dotted.field → ref}` projection of `RunManifest`: `assemble` writes it
as `resolved_dependencies.run_refs{run_id}`; `check_completeness`'s S1
stage re-derives it from the *exported* `lifecycle.run.created` payload
(the ledger page bytes, not the caller's copy) and compares both
directions — a manifest reference the index lacks and an index entry the
manifest does not carry both fail `manifest_reference_unresolved`
(a stale claim is the same completeness break as a missing ref — CC3).
`extra` members are uninterpreted: they ride the manifest verbatim and
are never claimed (ADR-0290 D1).

**`reproduce(R3, seeds[])` budget-matches every leg; the verdict names
its validator set and reports distributions, never means.** Each
`seeds[]` member must carry `eval_budget`/`search_budget` equal to the
bundle's declared budgets — else `Refused{UnbudgetedArm{seed}}` and the
leg never enters a distribution (matched-budget-or-refuse, CC9). The
compiled `RuntimePlan.validators` propagate into
`resolved_dependencies.validators[]` at assemble; an R2+ report names
the set it re-derived under (`[]` is the honestly empty set).
`distributions[]` is one `{seed, outcome, drift}` row per declared leg
(ADR-0290 D2).

**Views re-derive bit-exact from the bundle alone.** The conformance
test decodes the delivered bundle's ledger pages — no live store — and
re-runs `context_view`/`effect_ledger`: identical `view_hash`es and
identical canonical payloads; `version_id` recomputes equal; R0/R1
reproduce deterministically (AC-R-2.12.1-9).

**The M2 capability–cost frontier renders provenance honestly.**
`hh-analysis` gains the `frontier` analysis kind: a *comparison* surface
that runs under the same `hh_budget::matchspec::validate_match` gate as
`compare` (matched_cap/iso_cost only; exploratory `mode:none` refuses —
§8.2's "may execute but may not report comparisons"; the refusal
vocabulary is `CompareError::Match`, never a second validator). Cells
aggregate per `(arm, provenance_class, currency)` — within-currency sums
only, cross-currency cells are `incommensurable` and never dominate each
other. A cell is frontier-point admissible only when every contributing
row is `exact`/`bounded` with `coverage = 1`; `estimate`/`unknown`/
partial coverage renders a *band* — separate per-class frontiers plus a
combined band, per AC-R-2.1.6-8 (ADR-0043 D4 carried into M2; ADR-0290
D3). `SpendRowFact` gains `provenance_class`/`confidence`/`coverage_ppm`/
`currency` so the frontier stratifies on the projected fact — never a
raw-payload rescan (CC5); the `ledger_facts/1` codec round-trips them
(CC7). The compliance metric stays in `hh-eval`/`hh-ontology` — not
re-declared.

**The four-layer conformance kit is the `registry_ci` driver.**
`hh-varhost::kit` runs `protocol` (declared-op round trip + the
closed-sum `UnhandledOperation` check), `isolation` (the mediated probe
battery — a probe the plugin *executed* is the failure; the host's
typed refusal is the evidence; a probe answering `succeeded` is
isolation absent), `class` (self-report + the guard property — a forged
`allow` surfaces as `AuthorityCrossing` → `no_decision`), and `reach`
(static manifest checks + the same battery). The null plugin passes all
four layers; the hostile fixture fails L2 and L4 with typed refusals.
The `probed` floor gates on the kit's `registry_ci` report;
`publisher_claim` registers but never satisfies `probed` (self-report
is not evidence — ADR-0152 D3; ADR-0290 D4).

**M19 `boundary_overhead_ms` is measured, and OQ-075 rides the debt
machinery.** Both lanes (`in_process` / `subprocess_confined`) run at
matched cap (same N — CC9); every confined invocation carries a measured
`boundary_overhead_ms`; the headline is unchanged within the
pre-registered margin. The measured p95 becomes the OQ-075 `hot_path`
ceiling *claim* — an `AssumptionDebtRecord` with a `ProbeRun` evidence
ref to the content-addressed distribution report, a `ProbeRun` removal
test, a `Date` expiry, `DebtClass::Empirical` (ADR-0290 D5).

**Retirement is settled and sealed, never automatic.** `hh-lab::debt`
gains the Stage-3 halves: `settle_removal_test` maps the
`RemovalVerdict` to a `DebtTransition` — pass ⇒ retirement-*eligible*
(status unchanged until the seal), fail ⇒ `revalidated{evidence_ref}`
returning expiring/expired to active, inconclusive ⇒ reschedule;
`retire` is human-sealed and refuses unevidenced or non-human authority.
`expired_used` payloads mark debt referenced after expiry — excluded
from the headline count and surfaced beside it, never dropped and never
silently counted. `DebtReport` is the minimal derived view. Every rule
of both minimal profiles registers a `retirement` experiment; all six
`hh-lab` retirement tests are green (ADR-0290 D6).

## Deviations

- ADR-0290 D1–D6 (see Summary). No spec contradiction found; the
  `run_refs` vocabulary, the seed-leg budget gate, the point-vs-band
  stratification, the kit's probe semantics, the OQ-075 debt-record
  treatment, and the settle/retire authority split are the
  ticket-owned rulings.
